lines.text: Meta runs more than twenty thousand features to rank ads.
A feature is a small fact a model uses, like clicks in the last seven days.
lines.title: What is a feature?

lines.text: Features were bundled in one shared graph, so one error blocked every release.
lines.title: The old way

lines.text: At startup, the system finds shared work and puts it in a single order.
lines.title: Startup work

lines.text: All results sit in one memory buffer, so the CPU reads them quickly.
lines.title: Memory trick

lines.text: New features now reach production about three point six times faster, at no extra compute cost.
lines.title: The result

lines.text: Separate shipping from running, and do repeated work once at startup.
lines.title: Takeaways
